seasons.note: Seventeen and thrown into a relegated QPR side; rated as the raw teenager.
Joined Norwich from Oldham in February 1994.
Thirty-three starts at 35 in a side that survived; the energy had faded but the passing and positioning had not.
Twelve goals from fifteen starts as a 22-year-old; a real step up from the fringe player of the previous season rather than a scoring fluke.
